history.title: Analyses
history.description: Resume work or open an immutable completed report.

empty.title: No analyses
empty.fresh: Create your first analysis to see it listed here.

history.caption: Market analysis history

create.pageDescription: Configure a market window, verify its data, and carry the result through chart, story, design, generation, and publishing.
create.title: Start a market analysis
create.primaryDescription: Select one to three tokens. Price data is fetched from each token's configured public provider.
create.brandingDescription: This token supplies the visual style and footer when several controlled tokens share one analysis.
create.comparisonDescription: Add up to three live Binance USDT markets from the latest persisted catalog. The analysis supports six series in total.
create.searchError: Market search is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
create.noSearchResults: No active USDT market matches this search.
create.catalogUnavailable: The Binance market catalog is not ready. Let its refresh finish, then reload this page.
create.scaleDescription: Relative compares percentage movement; absolute preserves each series value.
create.unavailableBody: This installation has no enabled controlled token with a configured branding profile.

errors.primary: Select at least one controlled token.
errors.primaryLimit: Select no more than three controlled tokens.
errors.primaryDuplicate: Each controlled token can be selected only once.
errors.branding: Choose which selected token supplies the branding.
errors.comparisonLimit: Select no more than three market comparisons.
errors.comparisonDuplicate: Each market comparison can be selected only once.

shell.locked: Complete the preceding stage to unlock {step}.

dirty.title: Discard unsaved changes?
dirty.description: This step has changes that have not been saved or approved.
dirty.error: The step could not be changed.

market.title: Set up your market analysis
market.description: Choose the tokens, comparisons, and market window, then fetch verified prices.
market.refreshFailedBody: The latest refresh did not replace the accepted snapshot. Review the details below or try again.
market.seriesFailedTitle: Some series could not be verified
market.seriesFailedRetry: Review the sources below, then use Fetch & continue to try again.

warnings.coverage_late_start: Data starts later than the requested window.
warnings.coverage_early_end: Data ends before the requested window.
warnings.insufficient_observations: The provider returned too few valid observations.
warnings.common_window_clipped: This series was aligned to the shared comparison window.
warnings.malformed_provider_points_dropped: Invalid provider points were removed before verification.
warnings.fallback_mapping_used: A fallback market source supplied this series.
warnings.window_clipped: The provider covered only part of the requested window.
warnings.provider_unavailable: A configured market source was unavailable.
warnings.provider_rate_limited: The market source is refusing further requests right now (rate limit). Try again shortly.
warnings.generic: The provider returned a data-quality note.

failures.MARKET_SERIES_UNAVAILABLE: No usable market data was available for this series.
failures.MARKET_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The configured market source is currently unavailable.
failures.VALIDATION_FAILED: The returned market data did not pass verification.
failures.generic: This series could not be verified.

market.detailDescription: Per-series prices, change, and provider notes from the latest snapshot.

chart.title: Design and approve the verified chart
chart.description: Controls update the deterministic preview locally. Approval saves these exact values and requests the canonical PNG in one transaction.
chart.notReadyBody: Return to Market and verify at least one series.

previewErrors.generic: Review the chart controls and choose a valid combination.

chart.saveFailed: Chart values could not be saved
chart.renderPending: Rendering the canonical chart. Continue unlocks when it is ready.
chart.renderFailedTitle: The canonical chart was not rendered
chart.renderFailedBody: Retry the render to continue. The approved chart values are kept.

validation.title: Validation
validation.uniqueColorsHint: Two series share a color. Give every series a distinct color.
validation.colorContrastHint: A series color is too close to the background. Raise its contrast to at least {ratio, number}:1.
validation.timelineHint: The verified window does not cover the requested {period}. Refresh the market data.

story.title: Shape the market story
story.description: Write the headline and chart text from the locked verified facts.
story.headline: Headline
story.factsLocked: Locked facts from your data. Cannot be edited.
story.eyebrow: {count, plural, one {{period} market performance} other {{period} market comparison}}

design.title: Choose template family
design.description: Pick the family, then the version that carries this market view.
design.notReadyBody: No usable design samples are configured for this market analysis.
design.incompatibleTitle: This sample does not fit the current chart
design.reasonFormat: Choose a sample that supports this post format.
design.reasonSeries: Choose a sample for {min, number}–{max, number} chart lines.
design.reasonScale: Choose a sample that supports the current chart scale.
design.saveFailed: Design values could not be saved

generate.title: Generate the finished market image
generate.description: Pick the image model, add optional direction, then generate and approve the final post.
generate.actionFailed: The generation action could not be applied

fallback.MODEL_INVOCATION_FAILED: The brief service did not return an accepted result, so the approved deterministic brief was used.
fallback.STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INVALID: The brief result did not pass policy, so the approved deterministic brief was used.
fallback.generic: The approved deterministic brief was used. Design facts remain unchanged.

phaseBody.queued: The durable operation is waiting for its next worker step.
phaseBody.briefing: The approved Design facts are being shaped into the bounded image brief.
phaseBody.generating: The image is being generated from the pinned brief and references.
phaseBody.finalizing: The returned image is being verified and composed with the factual lockup.
phaseBody.ready: The current final image is ready for operator inspection.
phaseBody.failed: Generation ended without a usable final image.
phaseBody.cancelled: This generation was cancelled before completion.
phaseBody.superseded: A newer generation replaced this result.
phaseBody.unknown: The external outcome is ambiguous. Do not assume success or failure.

errors.recovery: Review the current state and try again. If this analysis changed in another tab, refresh first.

generate.directionHint: Optional. Style guidance only — the verified facts, approved chart and brand rules never change.
generate.directionPlaceholder: For example: keep the background calm and the typography tight.
generate.reference1Alt: Approved template sample used as the style reference
generate.reference2Caption: Only source of prices, dates and chart geometry
generate.reference2Alt: Approved chart PNG used as the factual reference
generate.referenceNote: Sample prices and the sample chart are ignored. The approved chart replaces them completely.
generate.previewEmpty: No image yet. Generate the finished post to see it here.
generate.sidebarNote: Review the final image preview before approving. Approval locks the image for publishing.

publish.title: Create the caption and publish
publish.description: Pick the platform, generate three caption options, choose and edit one, then save, schedule or publish.
publish.prepareFailedBody: Review the message below and try preparing this platform again.
publish.finishFailedBody: Approve the final image again or wait for the running operation to settle, then try again.
publish.finishBlocked: Save or discard your caption edits before finishing.
publish.discardDescription: Unsaved copy changes will be discarded before switching.
publish.commandError: The copy command could not be applied.

report.summary: Approved poster, chart, story, and publishing status.
report.handoffsBody: Live status for captions you saved, scheduled, or published.
report.noHandoffs: No platform captions were prepared for this analysis.
report.prepareAnotherBody: Generate captions for a platform you have not prepared yet. The approved poster stays unchanged.

integrityBody.available: The file is ready to view or download.
integrityBody.temporarily_unavailable: The file could not be loaded right now. Refresh and try again.
integrityBody.integrity_mismatch: The file needs verification before it can be opened. Refresh shortly.
integrityBody.bytes_removed: The file is no longer available for viewing or download.
integrityBody.reconciliation_required: Availability is still being checked. Refresh shortly.

errors.validation: Review the analysis values and try again.
errors.notFound: This analysis is no longer available.
errors.conflict: The analysis changed. Reload it, review your values, and submit again.
errors.completed: Completed analyses are immutable. Create a new analysis to rerun it.
errors.notReady: Complete the required approved stage before continuing.
errors.idempotency: This request key was already used with different values.
